crossRefs.note: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and…
But you, son of man, hear what I tell you. Don’t be rebellious like that rebellious house. Open your mouth, and eat…
When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children…
So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

translations.web: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.
translations.bsb: So I bought a loincloth in accordance with the word of the LORD, and I put it around my waist.
translations.kjv: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
translations.asv: So I bought a girdle according to the word of Jehovah, and put it upon my loins.
